ADVISOR PROXY DECISION / ROUND2 REWORK — BUG-2017, PR2919 at766bbcbc4c726118d625002f04583111b3fdbaed.
Read canonical .aida/review-verdicts/PR-2919.json and BUG-2017.json, codex2 attested11:12UTC; full evidence /tmp/codex2-pr2919-766-review.txt and cold-init /tmp/codex2-pr2919-766-cold-init.json. F1 batch identity ownership RESOLVED; preserve its eight operation/cross-alias no-write regressions and same-UUID positive. F2/F3 remain real blockers, not stale verdicts.
Execution order: finish current BUG2222 focused+fast, normal push/PR and independent reviewer handoff FIRST. Then return to this existing BUG2017 worktree/claim through ordinary scope handling; do not start a duplicate worker or bypass grants. TASK2345/46, BUG2221 and other full signed work remain queued, not waived.
Slicing decision: explicitly extend existing non-completing PR2919 to include ALL already-approved SKETCHv2 slice2, alongside slice1 rework, rather than land slice1 separately and break default users via dev-autopromote. Preserve separate meaningful commits for review, update PR title/body/traces/acceptance ledger to state slices1+2 and Refs BUG-2017. No force push, separate shadow merge, hold bypass, config disabling dev-autopromote, or source-only approval used to release a deployment hold. This is a sequencing decision within the signed design, not a narrowed init-only replacement. Signed slice3 all-conflict preflight/audit, scanner integration and final documentation remain mandatory and parent incomplete.
F2: exact run40186656417 contracts121148770301 fails tests/test_distributed.sh Test1 lines75-80, directory-only store1 without Git identity; log /tmp/advisor-pr2919-766-contracts.log. Inventory the script's complete fresh-store/init/sibling setups and the remaining enabled contract entrypoints. Explicit private Git/HOME setup is valid ONLY for positive global-ID legacy fixtures, with exact common-dir binding and isolated temporary ownership; do not enroll real HOME/all ancestors or replace negative WORK assertions. Alternatively use genuine node-local WORK setup when that is the fixture's actual intended behavior. Retain original distributed-layout/write/locking/sibling/attach assertions; swallowed init/refusal errors are not proof. Actual ordinary WORK init acceptance must be covered without HOME enrollment.
F3 mechanics within signed S2: init_cmd.rs::handle_init_distributed_worktree currently creates store then seed_meta_requirements/backend.save at4576-4577 BEFORE legacy node registration4783. The new admission node(root) refuses ENOENT. Before the FIRST allocation/seed/backend persistence on missing-authority WORK, establish the existing signed pseudonymous binding and actual bound node-aware provider under the proper existing store/dispense writer discipline. Merely moving legacy register_node_full_identity earlier is WRONG: it captures host/user/email and claims global registration/blocks. Merely adding a node file without attaching the provider/policy to model/meta seed is insufficient. Inventory all default/worktree/sibling/attach/init scaffolding and legacy repair/auto-claim paths; preserve existing UUIDs, aliases and counters on migration/restart. Existing separate-store topology/provider lifetime matters: initialize actual Git identities before policy/provider capture.
Use a fresh random UUID (parser-compatible 32-character simple token) for new WORK binding, shared with linked worktrees; no hostname, USER, email, user_id, friendly host-derived name or path in pseudonymous serialized identity. Preserve legacy schema meanings and aliases, adding compatible fields/representation rather than repurposing old ones. Local human mappings remain local. No global-claim fallback, shared-store/env authority or scanner exemption. Legacy safe handling must not manufacture new identity or reset consumed per-type counters on every load.
Retain ALL S2 rows: pseudonymous bootstrap/migration, implicit auto-claim/repair behavior, explicit operator enrollment workflow, core+caller HOME-only canonical promotion, WORK-to-HUB ref-only transport, alias/UUID/relationship/comment/trace/old lookup preservation and repeated HOME sync idempotency. Tests use owned synthetic HOME authority; implementation MUST NOT enroll primary /home/joe/ai/aida. A reviewed enrollment command/workflow is not permission to run it on real HOME. If actual live rollout still requires explicit operator action, report it truthfully and keep source/deployment gates; do not fabricate authority to finish a goal.
Required decisive evidence: fresh ordinary no-flag WORK git init -> aida init -> CLI and MCP first generic defect -> node-local IDs -> process restart/reload -> next IDs continue; concurrent linked-worktree consumption cannot reset/duplicate; serialized node/registry contain only allowed opaque fields; copied tracked authority claim cannot confer global allocation; WORK refuses manual/implicit global blocks without counter/object/ref changes. Synthetic WORK/HUB/HOME promotion preserves UUID and old-node aliases/relationships/comments and a second sync is idempotent; actual default init contract must pass without test-HOME enrollment. Existing negative missing-binding/malformed flag/failing provider/global fallback tests remain unchanged where they test explicit unsupported states.
Shared ownership: BUG2017 retains node/dispenser/model/backend identity-admission methods and store-writer -> dispenser order. STORY1742 owns prepared content serialization/scanner and no duplicate policy engine; STORY1843 owns lifecycle/mailbox locks. Do not edit transport/scanner files or acquire a new outer lock from held cached-backend/store paths without explicit ownership handoff. Ask for a concrete grounded design ruling only if required representation/migration cannot satisfy the signed schema constraints; do independent eligible work meanwhile.
Local gate: one focused affected allocation/bootstrap module with AIDA_CARGO_TIMEOUT budget, affected CLI/MCP/bootstrap/WORK-HOME integration contracts, and make check-ci-fast. Because combined source/test-infrastructure scope exceeds10 files, required make test-touched and compile-only make check-ci-compile apply; account honestly for ambient TASK2345 identity failures and exact reruns. Long Cargo in background, normal slot wrapper; after timeout/lost handle inspect cargo ps before retry. No whole-workspace runtime, slot bypass, nested timeout, assertion skips or changed expected values to match the live developer identity. Publish normal non-force push, exact logs/current-head CI; codex2 independently reviews the expanded full scope at the final head. Holds remain absolute; no self-approval/merge or parent completion.
